'''Rynmar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="LARP" /> located in the [[Rynmar system/Legends|Rynmar system]]. It was situated in the [[Hapan Rim Worlds]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Rynmar lay at the junction of the [[Great Rim Route]] and [[Rynmar Trail]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], while another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked it to the [[Rainboh system/Legends|Rainboh system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Rynmar was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the rare [[hover beak]] creature. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], it was one of a number of select worlds whose fauna was showcased in the [[Atrium]], a public building in the [[Ord Mynock Freeport|only spaceport]] on the<ref name="LARP" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Mynockra system]]</ref> planet [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]].<ref name="LARP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rynmar was introduced in ''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]'', a [[West End Games]] sourcebook written by [[Tony Russo|Anthony Russo]] and published in [[1996]].<ref name="LARP" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Rynmar [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Rynmar itself, in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
